name: Matomo
description: Matomo describes itself as "privacy-first analytics you can trust," delivering accurate, GDPR-compliant analytics with full data ownership via self-hosted or cloud deployment.
best_for: Positioned for organizations wanting privacy-compliant analytics without vendor lock-in — enterprises prioritizing data ownership, public sector bodies with regulatory requirements, and teams seeking a Google Analytics alternative.

tiers.name: On-Premise Community
tiers.notes: Free forever, self-hosted, with unlimited users and hits; community forum support only.

tiers.name: Cloud Starter
tiers.notes: €29/month excluding tax for 50,000 hits/month, up to 30 websites and 30 team members included; annual billing gives about 2 months free.

tiers.name: On-Premise Team bundle
tiers.notes: Up to 5,000,000 hits/month; includes funnels, heatmaps, session recording, and form analytics.

tiers.name: On-Premise Business bundle
tiers.notes: Up to 30,000,000 hits/month; adds cohorts, multi-channel attribution, and white labeling.

tiers.name: On-Premise Enterprise bundle
tiers.notes: Up to 100,000,000 hits/month; adds A/B testing and SAML/LDAP authentication, unavailable on the lower on-premise bundles.

cons: The cheapest published On-Premise paid bundle (Team, €275/month) still caps at only 4 users and 5,000,000 hits/month — mid-size teams needing more seats must jump straight to the €1,450/month Business bundle.
SAML/LDAP single sign-on and A/B testing are only unlocked on the top On-Premise Enterprise bundle at €3,400/month, not on the far cheaper Team or Business on-premise bundles.

Matomo has publicly raised its On-Premise bundle pricing to fund ongoing development and security updates, meaning existing subscribers can see their bundle price increase on renewal, not just new customers.
features: Unsampled data with no sampling limitations
Cookieless tracking and data anonymization options
Self-hosted or cloud deployment with full data ownership
Funnel/flow analysis and raw data export

alternatives.name: Google Analytics
alternatives.description: A free analytics tool from Google measuring customer behavior across websites and apps.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses of every size wanting free, easy measurement unified with Google's ad platforms.

alternatives.name: Hotjar
alternatives.description: An experience-intelligence platform for understanding and improving user behavior on websites/apps.
alternatives.best_for: Product, design, and marketing teams wanting to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion.
